content: Hiring-manager-credible MLOps portfolio signals: real orchestration platform experience (Kubeflow/K8s) beyond notebook demos, end-to-end pipelines with production concerns (feature/data validation, deployment, monitoring) rather than a single tutorial script, and articulable engineering discipline (testing, CI, versioned artifacts) around the ML code. Generic finding, not KFP-specific -- treat as directional/LOW-confidence on specifics.
